title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct equation for calculating the wavelength must be provided.

title: Measurements Recorded
description: Important Criteria: The student must mention the measurements of L, d, and Δ used in the calculation.

title: Correct Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly substitute the measured values into the wavelength equation.

title: Units Included
description: Optional Criteria: The student should include appropriate units for wavelength in the final answer.

title: Calculation Accuracy
description: Important Criteria: The final calculated wavelength must be accurate based on the provided measurements.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all factors in the equation are accounted for.
